title: geum hispidum subsp. albarracinense
intro: Geum hispidum subsp. albarracinense, commonly known as the Spanish Avens, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Geum hispidum subsp. albarracinense are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which may help to reduce pain, improve wound healing, and modulate the immune system. However, further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of this plant for medicinal use.
